title: Skeptical Finnish ROV team calls it man-made and like a power line

tellings.quote: This must be man-made. This is constructed."

plain: In 2019 a Finnish crew sent a remotely operated underwater robot down to a strange object on the floor of the Baltic Sea. Their operator, who had been a skeptic, came back saying "This must be man-made. This is constructed," and likened part of it to a power line. A treasure hunter named Dennis Asberg, whose team found the object, tells Michels this as what the operator told him. If he is right, the shape on the seafloor was built by someone, not formed by nature.
